C1773.title: F5 BIG-IP Edge Device Misconfiguration Leads to Enterprise Breach
C1773.summary: Microsoft security researchers disclosed a multi-stage attack where threat actors exploited a security flaw in an internet-exposed F5 BIG-IP edge device to gain initial access, then moved laterally to internal Confluence servers to steal credentials and attempted Kerberos relay attacks to expand their foothold.
